description: This file contains implementation routines for handling lockfiles in a version control system, including path manipulation, symlink resolution, lock acquisition with retry logic, and error handling.

methods.name: void trim_last_path_component(struct strbuf * path)
methods.description: Removes the last component of a given path, effectively moving up one directory level.

methods.name: void resolve_symlink(struct strbuf * path)
methods.description: Follows symbolic links within a given path, resolving it to the real file or directory, with a maximum recursion depth.

methods.name: int lock_file(struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,int mode)
methods.description: Attempts to create and lock a file at a specified path, resolving symlinks unless prevented by flags, and appending a lock suffix.

methods.name: int lock_file_timeout(struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,long timeout_ms,int mode)
methods.description: Attempts to lock a file with retries and exponential backoff until a timeout occurs.

methods.name: void unable_to_lock_message(const char * path,int err,struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Constructs an error message when locking fails, indicating reasons and suggestions.

methods.name: NORETURN void unable_to_lock_die(const char * path,int err)
methods.description: Prints an error message and terminates the program if locking fails.

methods.name: int hold_lock_file_for_update_timeout_mode(struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,long timeout_ms,int mode)
methods.description: High-level function to acquire a lock with timeout and error reporting, controlling locking behavior.

methods.name: char * get_locked_file_path(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Retrieves the path to the locked file, stripping the lock suffix.

methods.name: int commit_lock_file(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Renames the lock file to its committed state, signaling a successful lock acquisition.

ctags.name: hold_lock_file_for_update_timeout_mode
ctags.signature: (struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,long timeout_ms,int mode)

ctags.name: lock_file
ctags.pattern: /^static int lock_file(struct lock_file *lk, const char *path, int flags,$/
ctags.signature: (struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,int mode)

ctags.name: lock_file_timeout
ctags.signature: (struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,long timeout_ms,int mode)

ctags.name: unable_to_lock_message
ctags.pattern: /^void unable_to_lock_message(const char *path, int err, struct strbuf *buf)$/
